description: This file implements a ring buffer (circular buffer) data structure, providing functions to create, destroy, insert, consume elements, and inspect the buffer state. It is part of the libwebsockets project, used for managing data in network communications.

methods.name: struct:lws_ring * lws_ring_create(size_t element_len,size_t count,void (* destroy_element)(void *))
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ring buffer with specified element size and count. Sets up internal pointers and allocates memory.

methods.name: void lws_ring_destroy(struct lws_ring * ring)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the ring buffer, calling destroy_element on each occupied element if provided.

methods.name: size_t lws_ring_get_count_free_elements(struct lws_ring * ring)
methods.description: Returns the number of free elements available for insertion in the ring buffer.

methods.name: size_t lws_ring_get_count_waiting_elements(struct lws_ring * ring,uint32_t * tail)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements currently waiting to be consumed, given a tail pointer.

methods.name: int lws_ring_next_linear_insert_range(struct lws_ring * ring,void ** start,size_t * bytes)
methods.description: Provides a pointer and size for inserting data linearly into the buffer, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: void lws_ring_bump_head(struct lws_ring * ring,size_t bytes)
methods.description: Advances the head pointer by a specified number of bytes, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: size_t lws_ring_insert(struct lws_ring * ring,const void * src,size_t max_count)
methods.description: Inserts data into the ring buffer, handling wrap-around and returning the number of elements inserted.

methods.name: size_t lws_ring_consume(struct lws_ring * ring,uint32_t * tail,void * dest,size_t max_count)
methods.description: Consumes (reads and removes) elements from the ring buffer, updating tail pointers accordingly.

methods.name: const void * lws_ring_get_element(struct lws_ring * ring,uint32_t * tail)
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest element in the ring buffer without removing it.

methods.name: void lws_ring_update_oldest_tail(struct lws_ring * ring,uint32_t tail)
methods.description: Updates the oldest_tail pointer after consumption, optionally destroying elements.

methods.name: uint32_t lws_ring_get_oldest_tail(struct lws_ring * ring)
methods.description: Returns the current position of the oldest_tail pointer.

methods.name: void lws_ring_dump(struct lws_ring * ring,uint32_t * tail)
methods.description: Outputs diagnostic information about the ring buffer state.
